text.text_excerpt: I stopped in here for a quick cup of iced coffee, since I happened to be in the area. The shop is small and very quaint and the woman working was nice and welcoming and happy to make chit chat with the customers. I love the atmosphere here. You almost feel as if you are in someone's house and the weather was nice on the day I was here, so the door was open. My iced coffee was delicious and potent. I like that you can add you own milk or cream, as I like to gauge how much I want in my coffee on a particular day. The "large" iced coffee is on the smaller side, as compared to other shops, but it's nice and strong without being overbearing or making me jittery. In other words- it was pretty p...

St. Coffee is a lovely little coffee shop on St. Claude with good drinks and friendly baristas. This place is FUNKY with a capital FUNKY. The inside has so much wood that you might mistake it for a (funky) cabin. The low relatively low ceiling doesn't feel claustrophobic - it hugs you like a nest. There are giant (funky) murals that blend folk art with graffiti stylings that are positively beautiful. I've only had the iced coffee and it was good, albeit inconsistent in strength. Give it a taste to evaluate its strength before dumping tons of milk in and you'll be good to go. The coffee beans are from (funky) Portland, not Coffee Roasters of New Orleans. *Oh Saint Coffee, I should be offering prayers, but instead I offer praise* With it being but a (extra dark roast) coffee bean's throw from my house + those friendly, speedy baristas (including one of my favorites, formerly from Orange Couch), tasty cold brew, not one but two non dairy milk options *and* vegan offerings for lunch and treats (haven't tried these yet), Saint Coffee is quickly becoming my go-to for coffee on the go. I wouldn't mind spending more time in there, though I haven't really been dwelling at coffee shops when I'm in town, probably because it's where I spend most of my days when traveling for work. It's small/cozy inside, but they have a really nice side patio, too, ...
